subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum at 6.4% p.a. for 3(3)/(4) years is Rs. 1,896. What will be the amount (in Rs.) of the same sum at the same rate in 6(1)/(4) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest = 6.4%

Time in the first situation = {3}{3over4} years = 15over4 years

Time in the second situation = {6}{1over4} years = 25over4 years

Simple interest = Rs. 1896

**Formula used:**

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = Principal + S.I.

Where, P = Principle, R = Rate of interest

T = Time and S.I. = Simple interest

**Calculation:**

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 1896 = (P×6.4×15)over(4×100) 

⇒ P = (1896×4×100)over(6.4×15) 

⇒ P = (1896 × 400)/96 = Rs. 7900

Simple interest on the same rate in {6}{1over4} years.

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ S.I = (7900×6.4×25)over(4×100) 

⇒ S.I. = (79 × 160)/4 = Rs. 3160

Amount = Principal + S.I

⇒Amount = (7900 + 3160) = Rs. 11060

**∴ Hence, the amount is Rs. 11060.**
